title: Rivet library package
description: Builds a publishable Rivet library: tsc emits .js / .jsx (JSX preserved for the consuming app's Rivet compiler) + .d.ts, then a package.json whose exports point at the emitted files.

tsConfig.description: tsconfig of the emit, relative to the project.

outputPath.description: Output folder, relative to the workspace root. Default dist/<projectRoot>.

sourceRoot.description: Source folder the emit is rooted at (the tsconfig's rootDir), relative to the project.

assets.description: Extra files copied from the project.
